title: Regular expressions are POSIX with Perl's classes, ASCII only
verdict: no lookaround or inline flags; `\d`, `\w`, `\s` ASCII; NULL without a match
description: Patterns are POSIX extended with `\d`, `\w`, `\s`, `\b` and `[[:alpha:]]`; `\d` does not match `٣`, `\w` not `é`, `\s` not a no-break space. Lookahead (`(?=…)`) and inline flags (`(?i)`) are invalid and raise; flags go in the parameter argument. An invalid pattern raises.
`REGEXP_LIKE` matches the whole string, `REGEXP_INSTR` searches. `REGEXP_SUBSTR` without a match is NULL. `REGEXP_REPLACE` takes `\\1` for a group; `$0` is literal.
reference: `regex_dialect`: RE2, `''` without a match. sverify's SQL writes only searches (`REGEXP_INSTR(…) > 0`) and raises on non-ASCII text for patterns with `\d`, `\w` or `\s`; extraction and replacement are refused.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT regexp_instr('aé1', '\\d'), regexp_instr('é', '\\w'), regexp_instr('\u00a0', '\\s'), regexp_instr('٣', '\\d'), regexp_like('abc', 'b'), regexp_like('abc', '.*b.*'), regexp_replace('abc', '(b)', '[\\1]'), regexp_replace('abc', 'b', '$0'), regexp_substr('abc', 'z')

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
